trusted_believer.text: Edith trusted you with the last thing the sea had not taken. Even dark, the great lamp feels like a promise kept for someone.

trusted_skeptic.text: Edith trusted you, though the dark glass gives nothing back. The great lamp waits above the water, asking for more certainty than you have.

skeptical_believer.text: The stories brought you here, but Edith never made them easy to believe. The great lamp stands cold beneath the lens, patient as the tide.

uncommitted.text: The lamp room is colder than the stair. At its center, the great light stands dead, its lens dark as a drowned eye.

great_lamp_choice.text: The wick is trimmed. Oil waits in the reservoir. Beyond the glass, the fog has swallowed the water whole.

lamp_lit.text: The flame catches low, then gathers. Light turns once through the lens and lays a pale road across the fog.

edith_vane.speaker: Edith Vane
edith_vane.text: I spent my final nights in the lamp room, listening for—

answering_flash_one.text: One answering flash blinks from far out in the fog.

answering_flash_two.text: A second answering flash answers from the same impossible distance.

answering_flash_three.text: A third answering flash burns white at the edge of the water.
